newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Britannia Airways flies Netherlands - NZ.
newsitem.headline: Britannia Airways flies Netherlands - NZ.

text.p: Britannia Airways has launched a Netherlands-New Zealand service this week which is believed to be the longest flight-ever from the Netherlands.
The new service operates from Maastricht-Aachen Airport in the south of the Netherlands to Australasia, a MAA spokesman said.

Departing on Tuesdays, the Boeing 767 flies to London then to Auckland in New Zealand. On alternate weeks the service either flies to Australia or New Zealand, he added. In Australia, the British carrier calls at Sydney and Melbourne.
It is likely that the Britannia service will continue through the winter season into February, said the spokesman.
Covering 18,888 km, the flight takes over 30 hours. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
